subject.title: fix(models): add provider request rate limits

question: Should OpenClaw core accept this provider-dispatch-only `models.providers.*.request.rateLimit` config surface now, or wait for the broader rate-limit design first?
rationale: The patch is a plausible narrow slice, but it creates a new public config and provider dispatch policy with local queue/rejection semantics that automation should not product-approve without maintainer intent.

options.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
options.body: Approve the opt-in provider HTTP pacing slice after rebase and preserve broader budgets, CLI/status, tool/channel, and observability work as follow-ups.

options.title: Pause For Broader Design
options.body: Keep the PR open or close it until maintainers define the full outbound API governance scope across providers, tools, channels, budgets, and status UX.

options.title: Move Policy Out Of Core
options.body: Use this PR only to identify missing plugin/API seams and route optional rate-limit policy to a plugin or ClawHub package.

recommendation.title: Accept Provider Dispatch First
recommendation.body: Approve the opt-in provider HTTP pacing slice after rebase and preserve broader budgets, CLI/status, tool/channel, and observability work as follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: They have the strongest current signal on the provider egress boundary and related product scoping.
